limitations: External cargo vehicle diagnostic informs an effective rolling-resistance sensitivity range, not physical estimates for the target GMTLSV nor a confidence interval. Selected near-flat slow winter measurements are DC-link gross positive draw, not pack-wide battery discharge. The holdout check does not establish accurate transportability; two of four holdout effective coefficients are just outside the training-derived range. All other cart physics, SOC reserve and charging are unchanged. No tuning on confirmatory simulation outcomes.
primary_estimand: Mean of per-seed battery saving 100*(off-on)/off within 12 cells; low/high minus base at each SOC/policy and 25% minus 100% at each parameter/policy (percentage points).
service_guard: Descriptive unadjusted 95% CI lower bound of on-minus-off completions strictly greater than -1 per 100, plus positive battery saving with Holm p<0.05; not formal joint noninferiority.
